item.text: {"claim_id":"C054","obligation_id":"C054-B-1","contract":"LIMIT_WARRANT","subject":"Customer silence does not directly measure satisfaction.","verdict":"SATISFIED","unresolved_conditions":[],"rationale":"T001 establishes that most customers send no support message, without establishing their satisfaction or reasons for remaining silent.
